evals.name: no-double-submit
evals.prompt: Write a rendered interaction for a create-shelf form that refuses blanks and submits exactly once.
evals.expected_output: Fresh rendered state, role queries, observable effect.
assertions: Checks disabled Add and no callback for blank input.
Types the name and activates the accessible control.
Checks the single payload and visible named row.

evals.name: focus-restoration
evals.prompt: A mocked story claims focus returns to the trigger after keyboard dismissal. Show how to prove it.
evals.expected_output: Use a real browser and keyboard.
assertions: Uses isolated browser and test data.
Opens and dismisses with keyboard input.
Asserts actual focused element, not a spy or screenshot.

evals.name: story-leak
evals.prompt: Opening the panel story twice leaves stale rows and a called spy. Fix the proof rather than loosening counts.
evals.expected_output: Reset story state at its owning boundary.
assertions: Creates fresh data and callback recorder on each render.
Scopes queries to the canvas or named portal.
Keeps exact argument, count and visible outcome checks.
